The '''father''' of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Datch also had brothers, one [[Tarrin Datch's sister|sister]], and a [[Tarrin Datch's mother|mother]]. The Datch [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were the proprietors of [[Pellezara station]], in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide" />

Tarrin's father once grounded his son for three weeks, literally, assigning him to work in traffic control and resupply, after attempting a miniature [[Koiogran turn]] in a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] that destroyed a dozen [[beacon pod]]s in the process.<ref name="Galaxy Guide" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Tarrin joined the Rebel Alliance. Although he missed his family, he knew better than to involve them in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], for their safety.<ref name="Galaxy Guide" />
